description: A few weeks ago someone called me out about my creative roadmaps living in G sheets...  I was offended.  However... she was RIGHT.  My friends at @Replit saw this going down and offered their new Agent 4 to help.  But even though I had never vibe coded anything IN MY LIFE...  Within minutes, I had a working agency dashboard that tracks tests across all my clients. ngl, it made me feel like a total baddie 🔥 Thank you, Replit. Now I can finally join the ranks of vibe coders :)  #ReplitPartner
transcript: I was super offended when I got this comment about my creative road maps but y'all I was just mad cause she was right so I decided to do something about it my friends at Replex saw this going down and they were like hey you can use our new agent for release which actually deploys multiple agents to plan code and design multiple things for you at once but I have never vibe coded anything to be honest I was still a little freaked out that it would be too technical for me then I remember the best thing about AI which is you can ask AI how to best use AI so I showed Claude my creative roadmap and I was like hey give me the best prompt that I can use to put inside of replet so that we can make this thing and within minutes I had a working prototype that I am now starting to use with my clients and I created an agency owner dashboard where I could see where the tests were across all of the clients like which ones are being delayed on my side which ones are being held up by something on the client side and which ones were launched a replica this made me feel like a total badass I am definitely gonna be riding this high for weeks so be sure to check out their new agent for release you can just do things so do them
